Spartak plays its home matches at the local [[Stadion Spartak (Varna)|Stadion Spartak]]. Founded in 1918, Spartak Varna established itself as one of the early pioneering clubs in [[Football in Bulgaria|Bulgarian football]]. Spartak won the Bulgarian league in [[1932 Bulgarian State Football Championship|1932]], and was runner up in 1931 and 1933. Spartak has spent the majority of its existence in the first tier of Bulgarian football, with the club’s most recent top flight participation being season [[2022–23 First Professional Football League (Bulgaria)|2022–2023]]. Spartak's nickname is the "Falcons", and the club has a rivalry with fellow Varna-based club, [[PFC Cherno More Varna|Cherno More Varna]]. Matches between the two sides are known as [[Varna derby|The Derby of Varna]]. The two sides even used to share the [[Yuri Gagarin Stadium]] before it was demolished."}}
